roles.name: Software Security
roles.description: Owns the secure SDLC: sets security requirements and policy, runs reviews, and drives the supply chain risk program.

roles.name: Business Management
roles.description: Accountable for compliance, third-party and supplier obligations, budget, and organizational risk acceptance.

roles.name: Architect
roles.description: Designs the system and its trust boundaries; makes secure design, component, and toolchain decisions.

roles.name: Developer / Developing
roles.description: Writes and integrates code and dependencies following secure development practices.

roles.name: Developer / Testing
roles.description: Builds and runs security test and scanning tooling; validates fixes.

roles.name: Information Technology
roles.description: Runs the development infrastructure and identity and access for the SDLC environment.

roles.name: Operations / Build
roles.description: Owns the build system and pipeline integrity, provenance, and hardening.

roles.name: Operations / Deploy
roles.description: Owns release, deployment, and the integrity of artifacts reaching production.

roles.name: Project Manager (Proposed)
roles.description: Proposed role: coordinates security work across teams and tracks remediation.
